'''Sharks''' were large carnivorous [[Fish/Legends|fish]].

Sharks were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The native [[Sedrian]]s sold products made out of sharkskin at the local market in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

Species of shark known throughout the galaxy were:
*[[Emerald shark]]
*[[Firaxan shark/Legends|Firaxan shark]]
*[[Floater (creature)|Floater shark]]
*[[Frist shark]]
*[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian razor shark|razor shark]]
*[[Lambro shark]]
*[[Swamp shark]]

The word "shark" was often found in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
